name: V1 the claim does not require an unused token
old:
AND used = FALSE
                  AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()::timestamp)
new: AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()::timestamp)

name: V2 the claim ignores expiry
old: AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()::timestamp)

name: V3 a token naming another account still signs in
V4 the cancellation's spent token is ignored (claim not conditional on the row)
old:
WHERE token = %s
                  AND user_id = %s::uuid
                  AND used = FALSE
new:
WHERE token = %s
                  AND user_id = %s::uuid
                  AND (used = FALSE OR TRUE)
